text: “God is the ruler. He makes people fear and respect him. He keeps peace in his kingdom above.
No one can count his stars.[1] His sun rises on all people.
How can anyone claim to be right before God? No human being[2] can really be pure.
In God’s eyes even the moon is not pure and bright; even the stars are not pure.
People are much less pure. They are like maggots, as worthless as worms!”
